title: Vegan Poutine Fritters
description: A twist on the classic Canadian dish, these vegan poutine fritters are perfect for a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, mash the tofu, mashed potatoes, ummi-flavored lentils, and nutritional yeast until well combined.
Add the canned poutine, beef-free broth, and vegan breading to the mixture. Stir until a thick batter forms.
Using a cookie scoop or spoon, drop the batter onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the fritters for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite toppings, such as additional poutine or a dollop of vegan sour cream.
